Alex: Hi, Ms. Kim. We’re watching some videos for
the science project.
Ms. Kim: That’s good, but ___________________________.
Minji: Why? Is there something wrong with our necks?
Ms. Kim: Yes, you’re looking down at the smartphone.
It’ll increase stress on your necks, and you
can get text neck.
Minji: Oh, really? I didn’t know that. What should
we do?
Ms. Kim: When you use your phone, you should
hold it at eye level.
Minji: Okay, we’ll start doing that.

stretching exercises.
